operations.readiness_independent: UP describes registration; service readiness is checked separately
operations.readiness_probe_failed: The probe could not confirm whether this service is ready
operations.readiness_reason_pd_quorum_not_ready: This PD has not yet met the service readiness conditions
operations.readiness_reason_pd_raft_error: This PD reports a terminal Raft error
operations.readiness_reason_pd_raft_shutdown: This PD Raft node is stopping or has stopped
operations.readiness_reason_store_starting: The Store is starting; registration may already be UP
operations.readiness_reason_store_stopping: The Store is stopping and is not ready to serve
operations.readiness_reason_readiness_not_probed: Only the PD member matching the configured endpoint is probed; this member was not probed
operations.readiness_reason_readiness_target_unmapp: The configured PD endpoint cannot be mapped uniquely to this member
operations.readiness_reason_readiness_response_unre: The response body does not match the readiness contract; HTTP 200 alone does not establish readiness
operations.readiness_reason_readiness_auth_rejected: The endpoint returned an authentication error envelope, possibly with HTTP 200
operations.readiness_reason_unsupported_version: This service does not expose the readiness endpoint
operations.readiness_reason_stale_readiness: Collection failed; this is an earlier readiness observation
operations.readiness_action_pd_quorum_not_ready: Check that a majority of PD members are online and Raft peer addresses are reachable. Inspect PD election logs, then refresh after recovery
operations.readiness_action_pd_raft_error: Inspect PD Raft/snapshot logs, disk space and storage errors. Correct the underlying failure before restarting the affected PD
operations.readiness_action_pd_raft_shutdown: Check for planned shutdown or restart, inspect the PD process and Raft logs, then refresh after recovery
operations.readiness_action_store_starting: Inspect Store initialization logs and its PD connection. Refresh after startup; persistent STARTING needs investigation
operations.readiness_action_store_stopping: Confirm whether maintenance or shutdown is intentional. Inspect Store logs, then refresh when it is online
operations.readiness_action_readiness_not_probed: Check this member at /v1/ready directly. Hubble does not infer its readiness from another PD
operations.readiness_action_readiness_target_unmapp: Compare configured/member REST addresses in source diagnostics. Correct origin or proxy path mismatches, then refresh
operations.readiness_action_readiness_response_unre: Check service version and probe response. Confirm a proxy routes to the service rather than an authentication or HTML page
operations.readiness_action_readiness_auth_rejected: Check Hubble PD/Store credentials and whether the service version supports this probe
operations.readiness_action_unsupported_version: Use an image supporting this probe or inspect readiness directly. Registration and metrics remain independent
operations.readiness_action_stale_readiness: Refresh for a current observation; an earlier successful probe does not prove current readiness
operations.readiness_action_default: Inspect the request path and HTTP status. Check service connectivity, trusted Store targets and service logs, then refresh
operations.reason_service_not_ready: A registered node reports its service is not ready
operations.diagnostic_recovered_help: The latest collection succeeded. Compare the last observed and last success times to confirm recovery
operations.source_diagnostics_help: A collection failure does not by itself mean a node is down. Compare node status with collection status below
operations.diagnostic_reason_unavailable: No source error details were reported
operations.diagnostic_large_response_action: The response was stopped at the configured collection limit. Check the failed endpoint and follow the steps below.
operations.diagnostic_check_source_action: Check the affected request, node metric groups and upstream logs, then refresh to confirm recovery.
operations.reason_pd_metrics_unmapped: The configured PD endpoint could not be matched to a discovered PD node
operations.diagnostic_pd_mapping_action: PD topology was discovered, but system metrics were not assigned to a node because the configured endpoint could not be uniquely matched to a member's restUrl in the PD member list.
operations.lifecycle_independent: Process lifecycle reports startup and shutdown events only. It does not establish PD membership, partition health or read/write readiness
operations.lifecycle_unsupported: Not supported by this Store version
operations.diagnostic_pd_endpoint_sample_help: One response from the configured endpoint. A Service or proxy may route each request to a different member; these values do not identify a node or represent a cluster total
operations.diagnostic_step_pd_endpoint: A Service, proxy or load-balancer address can reach PD without identifying a single member. Compare the configured address with the member REST addresses below; an address mismatch alone does not mean PD is down.
operations.diagnostic_step_pd_config: To collect CPU and JVM metrics, set pd.server in hugegraph-hubble.properties to a reachable member REST address, or correct the advertised restUrl. A scheme-less pd.server uses server.protocol. This changes the PD connection endpoint, so retain the intended deployment routing.
operations.diagnostic_step_pd_restart: Restart Hubble after a configuration change, then refresh. Hubble collects system metrics from only the one matched PD member; other members remain intentionally uncollected.
operations.diagnostic_step_response_limit: operations.max_response_bytes in hugegraph-hubble.properties limits each upstream response; the current limit is shown with the failed request. “At least” is a lower bound from a stopped read, not the full response size.
operations.diagnostic_step_raft_summary: The older /metrics/raft endpoint returns full registries and timer samples for every Raft group. Upgrading Store to a version that provides /metrics/raft/summary lets Hubble collect just the two counters.
operations.diagnostic_step_response_config: Inspect the full response size from the same endpoint. If the payload is expected, increase operations.max_response_bytes to fit the measured response within the available memory budget, restart Hubble, then refresh. A larger limit applies to every collection request.
operations.diagnostic_pd_online_unmapped: PD nodes are online; system metrics could not be attributed
